zpd.title: Interactive ZPD Calculator
zpd.scenarioHint: Change the values to simulate different scenarios and check the recommended pedagogical steps for your next intervention.

zpdSteps.step1: Return to basic concepts. Focus on consolidating prior knowledge through diagnostic tasks.
zpdSteps.step2: Consolidation with same-type tasks (Scaffolding). Dose assistance until autonomy increases.
zpdSteps.step3: Introducing a new concept (Weak zone of proximal development). Encourage transition to abstract solving.
zpdSteps.step4: Advanced extension! Tasks should include real scenarios, high critical thinking and self-evaluation.
